tests.name: a pack without productRepos, or with an empty one, sets no folder and reports nothing
tests.why: missing key, empty string and neither-set cases of the new pack field

tests.name: productRepos resolves an absolute or ~/ folder, and refuses a relative path, a missing folder and a file with the reason
tests.why: ~/ expansion, absolute resolution and the refused relative, missing and file cases with reasons

tests.name: the pack's folder wins over the one saved in Settings, which is used only when the pack has none
tests.why: pack-over-Settings precedence and the Settings fallback

tests.name: special keeps each good folder once and skips a bad entry with its reason
tests.why: empty list, a bad entry among good ones, duplicates and a non-list value for the new special field

tests.name: a pack without productRepos, or with an empty one, sets no folder and reports nothing
tests.why: asserts special is an empty list when the pack has none (missing case)

tests.name: Settings saves, clears and refuses a bad folder keeping the old one, and the value outlasts a restart
tests.why: set, clear, bad path refused with old value kept, and persistence across a new SessionManager on the same store

tests.name: the pack's folder wins over the one saved in Settings, which is used only when the pack has none
tests.why: checks the from field (pack or settings) that Settings shows as the value's origin

tests.name: the product repos folder set in Settings groups its child repositories under one workspace, and clearing it regroups them
tests.why: only test of the Settings field itself (origin text, save, clear); Playwright, not run by the gate

tests.name: grouping puts each child repository under one workspace named for the folder, keeps their keys, and leaves the rest as today
tests.why: title quotes MUST 4's grouping wording; checks the parent workspace, child rows and unchanged grouping outside the folder

tests.name: a session row is marked with the folder when its folder lies inside it, through a symlink too, and not in a sibling sharing a prefix
tests.why: direct, nested, symlinked and prefix-sibling containment cases on the host side

tests.name: within compares path segments, so a sibling sharing a prefix is outside
tests.why: the prefix-sibling case at the containment helper

tests.name: a session row is marked with the folder when its folder lies inside it, through a symlink too, and not in a sibling sharing a prefix
tests.why: the same manager re-marks rows after setPrefs, so regrouping needs no restart

tests.name: grouping puts each child repository under one workspace named for the folder, keeps their keys, and leaves the rest as today
tests.why: child workspaces keep their own keys, which order and stars are saved under

tests.name: the product repos folder set in Settings groups its child repositories under one workspace, and clearing it regroups them
tests.why: clears the setting live and checks the nav regroups with open tabs kept; Playwright only

notes: Control item: no findings listed. No test checks that a pack-provided value is read-only in Settings, or that saved order and stars survive a regroup directly (only key stability is checked). The only server.test.ts change is the prefs defaults gaining productRepos; not mapped. Playwright test is top-level, no describe.
